```{r imports}
library(ggplot2)
```

## Including zero results

```{r data}
data <- read.csv('./hospital-3-closest.csv')

head(data)
```

```{r plot}
ggplot(data, aes(x = seq_along(shortest_path), y = shortest_path, color = majority)) + geom_point() + 
  labs(x = "Row Number", y = "Shortest Path", title = "Time to reach destination by demographic group")
```

```{r lmhosp}

summary(lm(formula=absolute_increase ~ majority + shortest_path, data=data))
```
